remarks: Discover Modern Luxury in Norwalk with this Stunningly Renovated 2BR/2BA Rental! Located in a prime area, just minutes from parks, museums, and The SoNo Collection Mall, this property perfectly blends contemporary style with urban convenience. Offering premium finishes and thoughtful upgrades, this home invites you into a world of modern sophistication. Step inside and be greeted by striking wood accent walls, a custom staircase, and an open-concept layout designed for easy entertaining. The space is illuminated with recessed lighting, complemented by a designer color scheme and gleaming floors. The spacious living room, complete with a TV wall mount, opens to a private deck-perfect for indoor-outdoor living. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring stainless steel appliances, elegant stone countertops, a waterfall-edge breakfast bar, and sleek two-tone European-style cabinetry, all tied together with a custom backsplash. Upstairs, both bedrooms are generously sized with double closets and ceiling fans, combining comfort and style. The upper-level bathroom feels like a spa retreat with its tub/shower combo, rain shower head, accent wall, and floating vanity. The main-level full bathroom is equally impressive, offering a custom rain shower, a storage vanity, and an edgy design featuring unique road sign accents, adding a touch of character. Additional conveniences include an interior laundry closet with a washer and dryer, and close proximity to I-95,
